# Phase outcome

Strict public client. Entry: none. Exit: sibling Jidoka is active, private dependencies are guarded, and cancellation uses `Jidoka.cancel/2`.

# Ranked child stories

1. `jido_cli-tqg.1.1` — Use the sibling Jidoka checkout as the CLI development contract (P0)
2. `jido_cli-tqg.1.2` — Cancel interactive turns through Jidoka.cancel/2 (P0)

# Status rule

All child stories remain open. Story dependency links, not priority alone, control implementation order.
title: Phase 0: Establish the strict public Jidoka client
